_readme: Single source of truth for the site's Person and Organization entities. Every page that emits author/publisher JSON-LD reads THIS file via scripts/lib/entity.js and references the @id values -- no page hardcodes an author blob. To add a new corroboration point (ORCID, Wikidata, LinkedIn, Muck Rack), append the URL to person.sameAs here and re-run `npm run pages` + `npm run articles:index`; it propagates everywhere. See _personal/ARTICLE-WRITER-SPEC.md section 6.

person.name: James Shearn
person.description: James Shearn is the editor of LegislationPatch. He built the site's source-verification pipeline, which checks every published figure, date, and statutory citation against the official bill text before it ships, and he reviews and verifies each analysis and article before publication.
person._sameAsTodo: Ranked by machine-readability, best value first. (1) ORCID -- free, instant, no notability gate, persistent identifier: register at orcid.org and append the https://orcid.org/NNNN-NNNN-NNNN-NNNN URL. (2) Wikidata -- highest machine value but has a notability bar and can be deleted; the SITE is the likelier entity than the person. (3) Muck Rack -- journalist registry, domain-relevant. (4) LinkedIn / X / Bluesky -- lower machine value than commonly assumed.

organization.name: LegislationPatch
organization.description: An independent, nonpartisan project explaining U.S. federal legislation in plain English, patch-notes style. No political affiliation, no outside funding, no advertising.
